items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: We had a very good rhythm section with her. It was Al McKivven (PHONETIC), Kibbon, John Collins. I played piano, and Joe Jones on drums.

ctx.x: So you and John have been friends and musical associates. Have you worked together in between here, a year or so ago, and way back in the beginning?

Oh, we did work together in New York, after we both wound up in New York. This was with Sarah Vaughan, in Birdland. We had a very good rhythm section with her. It was Al McKivven (PHONETIC), Kibbon, John Collins. I played piano, and Joe Jones on drums.
